personality: 7 Dark-First Utility structure with 6 Glass / Luxe surfaces
personality_one_liner: A high-end, data-driven command center that feels more like a premium black-card subscription than a generic fitness tracker.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room for luxury feel, but tight grouping for macro metrics. Never let data feel disconnected from its label.

do's: Use heavy frosted glass on the bottom tab bar to float above scrolling content.
Use glass for the Scan Meal camera overlay controls (bottom sheet & header).
Apply glass to the Premium paywall features list to add perceived value.
dont's: Never blur body text regions or form fields.
Avoid glassmorphism on dense data lists (like the detailed food diary).

screens.name: Onboarding & Goal Setup
screens.purpose: Collect stats and calculate BMR/TDEE while establishing the premium €1.99/mo aesthetic.

states.loading: A sleek, branded spinner calculating AI calorie requirements.
states.error: Failed to calculate stats. Retry button below.

screens.layout: Full-bleed background image with a vertical gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse) at the bottom. The CTA sits sticky at the bottom. Single column, centered content for the questions with large touch targets.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Command center for the day showing the calorie ring, macro breakdowns, and water tracking.

states.loading: Skeleton loaders for the calorie ring and macro tiles.
states.empty: Start your day by scanning a meal. Large placeholder illustration in the center.
states.error: Unable to load dashboard data. Pull to refresh.

screens.layout: Scrollable view. Compact sticky header with a day selector. Top hero card is a large circular progress ring for calories (BrandPrimary colored). Below it, a 3-column grid for macros (Protein, Carbs, Fat) using compact utility cards. Bottom section has smaller tracking widgets (Water, Streak). Tab bar is fixed.

screens.name: Scan Meal (Camera)
screens.purpose: The absolute visual hero of the app. A camera view to instantly recognize food.

states.loading: Glass overlay showing 'AI is analyzing your meal...' with a subtle scanning line animation.
states.error: Food not recognized. Manual entry button offered.

screens.layout: Full-screen camera preview. The top has a glass header with a 'Back/Close' button. The center has a high-contrast targeting frame bracket overlay. The bottom features a large, glassmorphic capture button and a small tip ('Ensure good lighting').

screens.name: Meal Confirmation
screens.purpose: Review AI findings, adjust portion size, and log the meal.

states.error: Could not log meal. Please try again.

screens.layout: Presents as a Bottom Sheet modal over the camera. Top half of the sheet shows a cropped image of the scanned food. Below, a clean list of detected items, a portion slider, and the total macros. A sticky 'Confirm & Log' primary button at the bottom.

screens.name: Food Diary
screens.purpose: A structured daily view of Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner, and Snacks.

states.empty: No meals logged yet today. Tap the scan button to start.
states.error: Unable to load diary. Tap to retry.

screens.layout: List layout grouped by meal type (Breakfast, Lunch, etc.). Each group header is sticky. Each logged meal is a horizontal card showing the food name, portion, and calories, with a subtle divider. Total calories for each group shown on the right.

screens.name: AI Assistant & Coach
screens.purpose: Chat interface for personalized nutrition advice.

states.empty: Chat starts with a greeting and 3 suggested prompts ('How many calories in an apple?', 'Suggest a high-protein dinner').
states.error: Connection lost. Reconnect to continue chatting.

screens.layout: Standard chat interface. Messages from the AI have a subtle surfaceTertiary background. User messages have a brandTertiary background. Input field is sticky at the bottom above the keyboard (KeyboardAvoidingView) with a send icon.

screens.name: Premium Paywall
screens.purpose: Convert free users to the €1.99/mo subscription.

states.error: Unable to load plans. Restore purchases or try again.

screens.layout: Cinematic full-bleed background image with heavy glassmorphism. Large 'C1 Premium' heading. A bulleted list of premium features using green success checks. Two prominent plan selection cards (Intro and Standard). Sticky 'Start Premium' button.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Dark-First Utility (7) structure fused with Glass / Luxe (6) materials. Base is Obsidian/Graphite, not the banned navy/indigo. Accent is Antique Gold (#D4AF37), achieving the 'premium subscription' feel instead of typical fitness app colors.
BANNED: Do not use any blue, indigo, violet, purple, or neon gradients. No typical 'AI slop' purple.

Implement RTL support (Arabic) by utilizing appropriate localized layout techniques in React Native (e.g., I18nManager) and ensure typography handles Arabic gracefully (IBM Plex Sans supports Arabic variants).
The 'Scan Meal' action must be the visual hero. Use a large Floating Action Button (FAB) anchored to the center of the bottom tab bar with an Antique Gold background or heavily frosted glass.
Use Glassmorphism (expo-glass-effect or expo-blur) heavily on elevated surfaces like the tab bar, sticky headers, and bottom sheets, backed by a translucent tint for text readability.
All imagery (onboarding, paywall) must feature a vertical gradient scrim overlay to ensure foreground text is fully readable (WCAG AA).
For the camera layout, prioritize a clean viewfinder with an overlay frame, keeping controls minimal and thumb-accessible.
Provide empty, error, and loading states for all screens. Ensure generous whitespace and use the 8pt grid token system strictly.
